note: WORK-10-DESIGN.md decision 6: one fixed query per section, written from the skill's shape table only, with two values filled from list_sources ({week_ending}, {latest_run}). No query names a file. Fixed before any recall is measured; the hash of this object's templates and tokenizer goes into every record. A change after the first recall run is a new version, and the page shows every version with its recall.
tokenizer: lowercase; ids (action ids A001, answer ids D202610300900-Q03, run ids R2026-10-30-1 and N2026-10-29-1, dates 2026-10-30) kept whole; every other token split on non-alphanumerics; no stemming; no stopwords

templates.what_moved: closed this week {latest_run} reconcile read merged held
templates.what_changed: orders revenue returns rate average order value period value last week
templates.open_questions: open question owner not stated asked for
